final: WITH station_counts AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), total AS (SELECT SUM(telescope_count) AS total_count FROM station_counts), shares AS (SELECT c.observstation, c.telescope_count, 1.0 * c.telescope_count / t.total_count AS share FROM station_counts AS c CROSS JOIN total AS t WHERE t.total_count IS NOT NULL), mean_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM shares) SELECT s.observstation, s.telescope_count, s.share, s.share - m.value AS difference FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN mean_share AS m WHERE m.value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10
